_evidence: 0x00409aec scans the 22 car records at 0x0066fef0 (stride 0x41c, loop count 0x16) with test byte [esi+0x415],0xff and stops at the first zero byte (je 0x409b12) or falls out of the loop (esi reset to 0x66fef0, ecx=-1). Only byte +0x415 (0x00670305 + k*0x41c) is read; it is state (static zero, so the scan always stopped at record 0). Each byte draws from 15 nonzero values and 0 (1/16), so the first zero lands at every depth and about a quarter of the cases scan all 22 records. Any byte value is valid.
